chapterCoverage.sql: SELECT c.*,l.targetBookId,t.name FROM link_coverage c JOIN link l ON l.id=c.linkId JOIN connection_type t ON t.id=l.connectionTypeId WHERE c.lineId=15827

chapterOutgoing.sql: SELECT l.*,t.name FROM link l JOIN connection_type t ON t.id=l.connectionTypeId WHERE l.sourceLineId=15827

chapterIncoming.sql: SELECT l.id,l.sourceBookId,l.sourceLineId,t.name FROM link l JOIN connection_type t ON t.id=l.connectionTypeId WHERE l.targetLineId=15827
